sn56.52:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave pokkharaṇī paññāsayojanāni āyāmena paññāsayojanāni vitthārena paññasayojanāni ubbedhena puṇṇā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā || ||
sn56.52:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaram yaṃ vā kusaggena udakam ubbhataṃ yaṃ vā pokkharaṇiyā udakan ti || ||
sn56.52:1.5: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam pokkharaṇiyā udakaṃ || appamattakaṃ kusaggena udakam ubbhataṃ
sn56.52:1.6: saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti pokkharaṇi yā udakam upanidhāya kusaggena udakam ubbhatan ti || || 4--5.
sn56.52:1.7: Evam kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || la || pe ||
